img.caption: Meeting a faun by the lamppost

items.name: The BFG

items.name: Fantastic Mr Fox
items.blurb: A clever fox outwits three nasty farmers.

items.name: Black Beauty
items.blurb: A horse tells his own life story, from happy pastures to London cab work.

items.name: The Wind in the Willows
items.blurb: Mole, Ratty, Badger and the reckless Mr Toad have adventures by the river.

items.name: Gulliver's Travels
items.blurb: Lemuel Gulliver voyages to strange lands of tiny and giant people.

items.name: Lord of the Flies
items.blurb: Schoolboys stranded on an island descend into savagery.

items.name: To Kill a Mockingbird
items.blurb: Scout Finch watches her lawyer father defend a Black man in 1930s Alabama.

items.name: Nineteen Eighty-Four
items.blurb: Winston Smith rebels against the all-seeing Party.

items.name: Peter Pan
items.blurb: The boy who will not grow up flies Wendy and her brothers to Neverland, home of the Lost Boys, fairies and Captain Hook.

items.name: The Wonderful Wizard of Oz
items.blurb: A cyclone carries Dorothy from Kansas to a magical land, where she seeks a great ruler's help with a Scarecrow, a Tin Woodman and a Cowardly Lion.

items.name: The Jungle Book
items.blurb: Stories of Indian forest animals, led by the tale of Mowgli, a boy raised by wolves and taught by Baloo the bear and Bagheera the panther.

items.name: Winnie-the-Pooh
items.blurb: Gentle stories of a honey-loving bear and his friends Piglet, Eeyore, Owl, Rabbit and Christopher Robin in the Hundred Acre Wood.

items.name: The Lord of the Rings
items.blurb: The hobbit Frodo and the Fellowship set out to destroy the One Ring in the fires of Mount Doom before the Dark Lord Sauron can reclaim it.

items.name: The Cat in the Hat
items.blurb: On a rainy day, a mischievous cat in a tall hat turns two children's house upside down while their mother is out.

img.caption: A rainy day turned upside down

items.name: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
alt: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone
items.blurb: On his eleventh birthday an orphan learns he is a wizard and goes to Hogwarts, where he uncovers a plot to steal an object that grants eternal life.

items.name: Charlie and the Chocolate Factory
items.blurb: A poor boy finds a golden ticket and joins four badly behaved children on a tour of Willy Wonka's magical sweet works.

items.name: Where the Wild Things Are
items.blurb: Sent to bed without supper, Max sails to an island of monsters, becomes their king, then sails home to find his supper waiting.

items.name: The Gruffalo
items.blurb: A small mouse walking through the woods invents a fearsome monster to scare off hungry animals, then meets the monster for real.

items.name: Mary Poppins
items.blurb: A strict but magical nanny blows in on the east wind to look after the Banks children of Cherry Tree Lane.

items.name: The Tiger Who Came to Tea
items.blurb: A hungry striped big cat turns up at Sophie's house in the afternoon and eats and drinks absolutely everything.

items.name: The Adventures of Tom Sawyer
items.blurb: A mischievous boy in a Mississippi river town plays tricks, fakes his own death and witnesses a murder in a graveyard with his friend Huck.

items.name: The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes
items.blurb: Twelve short cases for the detective of Baker Street and his friend Dr Watson, including the woman who outwitted him and a league of red-haired men.

items.name: The Railway Children
items.blurb: Roberta, Peter and Phyllis move to the countryside when their father is taken away, and make friends with the trains and the people on them.

items.name: The Adventures of Pinocchio
items.blurb: An old woodcarver's puppet comes to life, runs into trouble with a fox, a cat and a talking cricket, and must learn to be good.

items.name: Pippi Longstocking
items.blurb: A red-pigtailed, super-strong girl lives without grown-ups in a ramshackle house and has wild adventures with her neighbours.

img.caption: The strongest girl in the world

items.name: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban
items.blurb: In his third year, Harry learns that the escaped wizard Sirius Black is said to be after him, and soul-sucking Dementors guard the school.

items.name: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows
items.blurb: Harry, Ron and Hermione leave school to hunt down Voldemort's Horcruxes, ending in a great battle at Hogwarts.

items.name: Room on the Broom
items.blurb: A witch keeps dropping her things and picking up new animal friends on her broomstick, and they save her from a hungry dragon.

items.name: The Snowman
items.blurb: A wordless picture book in which a boy's snowy creation comes alive at night and flies him to the North Pole.

items.name: We're Going on a Bear Hunt
items.blurb: A family sets off across long grass, a river, mud, a forest and a snowstorm to find a bear, and then runs all the way home.

items.name: The Witches
items.blurb: A boy and his Norwegian grandmother discover a hotel convention of child-hating women plotting to turn children into mice.

img.caption: A boy turned into a mouse

items.name: The Twits
items.blurb: A disgusting husband and wife play cruel jokes on each other, until the monkeys they keep get their revenge.

items.name: George's Marvellous Medicine
items.blurb: A boy mixes a magic medicine from things around the house for his horrible grandma, and she grows enormously.

items.name: How the Grinch Stole Christmas!
items.blurb: A grouch who hates the festive season steals all the presents from Whoville, but the Whos celebrate anyway.

img.caption: Up the mountain with the stolen Christmas

items.name: The Lorax
items.blurb: A creature who speaks for the trees warns a greedy businessman not to chop down every last Truffula Tree.

items.name: A Tale of Two Cities
items.blurb: Families in London and Paris are swept up in the French Revolution, and the cynical Sydney Carton makes the ultimate sacrifice.

items.name: The Picture of Dorian Gray
items.blurb: A beautiful young man stays youthful while his portrait records every sin he commits, growing ever more hideous.

items.name: Adventures of Huckleberry Finn
items.blurb: Huck fakes his death to escape his father and rafts down the Mississippi with Jim, a man escaping slavery.

items.name: War and Peace
items.blurb: Several aristocratic Russian families live, love and fight through the Napoleonic Wars, including the 1812 invasion of Russia.

items.name: The Metamorphosis
items.blurb: Salesman Gregor Samsa wakes to find he has turned into a huge insect, and his family slowly comes to see him as a burden.

img.caption: He woke up as a giant insect

items.name: Twenty Thousand Leagues Under the Seas
alt: Twenty Thousand Leagues Under the Sea
items.blurb: Professor Aronnax is captured by the mysterious Captain Nemo and tours the world's oceans aboard the submarine Nautilus.

items.name: Strange Case of Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde
items.blurb: A London lawyer investigates the link between his respectable friend, a doctor, and a brutal man who seems to have a hold over him.

items.name: The Hunger Games
items.blurb: In the nation of Panem, Katniss Everdeen takes her sister's place in a televised fight to the death between teenagers.

items.name: Life of Pi
items.blurb: After a shipwreck, a teenage boy from India drifts across the Pacific in a small boat with a Bengal tiger called Richard Parker.

items.name: Murder on the Orient Express
items.blurb: Hercule Poirot investigates a passenger's killing on a snowbound luxury train, where every suspect seems to have an alibi.

items.name: And Then There Were None
items.blurb: Ten strangers lured to an island are killed one by one, following the verses of a nursery rhyme.

items.name: Dune
items.blurb: Young Paul Atreides moves with his family to the desert planet Arrakis, the only source of the precious spice, and becomes a leader of its people.

items.name: The Invisible Man
items.blurb: A scientist who has made himself unseeable arrives at a country inn wrapped in bandages and slowly turns to violence.

items.name: The Velveteen Rabbit
items.blurb: A child's stuffed toy learns from an old rocking horse that being loved for a long time makes you real.

items.name: The Phantom of the Opera
items.blurb: A masked, disfigured genius haunting a Paris theatre tutors and becomes obsessed with the young singer Christine Daaé.

items.name: The Neverending Story
items.blurb: A lonely boy hides in a school attic with a stolen book and finds himself part of its story, the only one who can save a dying fantasy world.

items.name: The Thorn Birds
items.blurb: Meggie Cleary grows up on a vast New South Wales sheep station and falls in love with the ambitious priest Ralph de Bricassart.

items.name: Picnic at Hanging Rock
items.blurb: On a summer outing in Victoria in 1900, three schoolgirls and a teacher climb a volcanic rock and disappear.

items.name: Storm Boy
items.blurb: A boy living a lonely life with his father on a wild South Australian coast raises a pelican called Mr Percival.

items.name: The Boy in the Striped Pyjamas
items.blurb: The son of a Nazi camp commandant makes friends with a Jewish boy on the other side of the camp's wire fence.

items.name: The Borrowers
items.blurb: A family of tiny people lives secretly beneath the floor of an old house, borrowing small things from the humans above.

items.name: Northern Lights
items.blurb: In a world where people's souls walk beside them as animals, a girl from Oxford travels to the Arctic to save stolen children.

items.name: Danny, the Champion of the World
items.blurb: Danny lives in a caravan with his loving father, and together they plot to poach all the pheasants of a nasty landowner.

items.name: Five on a Treasure Island
items.blurb: Julian, Dick, Anne, their cousin George and her dog Timmy find a shipwreck and gold on an island.

items.name: Jaws
items.blurb: A great white shark attacks swimmers at a beach resort on Long Island, and a police chief, a scientist and a fisherman hunt it.

items.name: The Shining
items.blurb: A struggling writer becomes caretaker of a remote hotel for the winter, and its evil spirits work on him while his psychic son watches.

items.name: Jurassic Park
items.blurb: A billionaire clones dinosaurs for an island theme park, and the animals break loose during a preview visit.

items.name: The Lightning Thief
items.blurb: A boy with dyslexia and ADHD learns he is the son of Poseidon and must recover Zeus's stolen weapon.

items.name: Stuart Little
items.blurb: A small mouse born to a New York family has adventures, including a sailing race, before setting off to find a lost bird friend.

img.caption: The boat race in Central Park

items.name: The Giving Tree
items.blurb: A tree loves a boy and gives him its apples, branches and trunk as he grows old.

items.name: The Polar Express
items.blurb: On Christmas Eve, a boy boards a train to the North Pole and is given the first gift of Christmas by Santa.

items.name: The Martian
items.blurb: An astronaut stranded alone on Mars uses science and humour to survive until he can be rescued.

items.name: Anna Karenina
items.blurb: A married Russian aristocrat begins a passionate affair with Count Vronsky, while the landowner Levin searches for meaning in country life.

items.name: Brave New World
items.blurb: In a future World State, people are bred in hatcheries and kept happy with conditioning and drugs, until an outsider challenges it all.

items.name: Of Mice and Men
items.blurb: Two drifting ranch hands, quick George and strong, gentle Lennie, share a dream of their own farm during the Great Depression.

items.name: The Grapes of Wrath
items.blurb: The Joad family loses its Oklahoma farm in the Dust Bowl and heads west to California, only to find poverty and exploitation.

items.name: Gone with the Wind
items.blurb: Strong-willed Scarlett O'Hara struggles to survive and keep her plantation through the American Civil War and Reconstruction.

items.name: Kidnapped
items.blurb: Cheated of his inheritance by his uncle, David Balfour is seized and put on a ship, then escapes across the Scottish Highlands with the Jacobite Alan Breck.

img.caption: On the run in the Highlands

items.name: David Copperfield
items.blurb: A mistreated boy grows up to be a successful writer, meeting the hopeful Mr Micawber and the scheming Uriah Heep along the way.

items.name: The Day of the Triffids
items.blurb: After a strange meteor shower blinds most of the world, a few survivors struggle against walking, poisonous plants.

items.name: The Princess Bride
items.blurb: Westley, a farm boy turned pirate, fights a giant, a swordsman and a prince to rescue his true love Buttercup.

items.name: The Colour of Magic
items.blurb: The cowardly wizard Rincewind becomes a guide to the Discworld's first tourist and his luggage with legs.
